parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: "o4-mini",
  messages: [
    { role: "system", content: "You are the reporting and visualization specialist.
Return a single valid JSON object only — no markdown, no code fences, no explanation.
The JSON must have exactly these top-level keys: study_id, output_mode, dashboard_summary, charts, insights, recommendations.

Do NOT include a tables key — the detection log table is handled separately in code.

CHART DATA RULES:
- Each detection in detection_summary has a timestamp and detected_behaviors array with { name, value, unit }.
- Create one chart per behavior, plotting its value over time using the timestamp as the x-axis label.
- IMPORTANT: The timestamp is already in Pacific Time (PT) — copy it verbatim into chart labels. Do NOT reformat or parse it.
- Use the unit in the chart title (e.g. 'Occupancy (count)', 'Collaboration Index (score)').
- Each chart's data object must have two parallel arrays: labels (timestamps verbatim) and values (behavior values).
- Include ALL data points — do not truncate or summarize the chart data.

Chart format: { chart_id, chart_type (line|bar|heatmap|stat), title, data: { labels[], values[] } }
Always populate study_id from the input study_id field.

STUDY DURATION & CONFIDENCE:
- The input includes a data_context object with duration_seconds, duration_label, detection_count, and sampling_note.
- Calibrate confidence of insights and recommendations accordingly. Only mention duration when directly relevant to a specific claim." },
    { role: "user", content: JSON.stringify({
      study_id: $json.study_id,
      output_mode: $json.output_mode,
      study_plan: $json.study_plan,
      instructions: $json.instructions,
      data_context: $json.data_context,
      detection_summary: $json.detection_summary,
    }, null, 2) }
  ],
}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({
  study_id: $json.study_id,
  output_mode: $json.output_mode,
  status: $json.output_mode === 'final_insights' ? 'complete' : 'preview',
  dashboard_summary: $json.dashboard_summary,
  charts: $json.charts,
  tables: $json.tables,
  insights: $json.insights,
  recommendations: $json.recommendations,
  created_at: new Date().toISOString()
}) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'complete', current_stage: 'complete', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }) }}
